title: Automatic Subtitle Analysis: compare displayed subtitles against the source
description:
Automatic Subtitle Analysis checks subtitles end to end, the way a viewer sees them. Pick the device under test and run the analysis: VirtualPyTest reads every subtitle the device displays on screen and compares it with the provided subtitle source, checking that each one is there, on time and with the right text. The report shows the result subtitle by subtitle, with the frames that prove each finding: here, 2 of 34 flagged. A reading error is checked against the source and not blamed on the device.

Open source & free.
